name: task_config
command: from pathlib import Path; from soup_cli.config.loader import load_config; c=load_config(Path('task/task.yaml')); print(dict(base=c.base,task=c.task,batch=c.training.batch_size,max_length=c.data.max_length,quantization=c.training.quantization,gradient_checkpointing=c.training.gradient_checkpointing,stream_layers=c.training.stream_layers,packing=c.training.packing,multipack=c.training.multipack))
